> 第722章 混合作战（第1页）
见到其余几人神色迟疑，他继续说出配套的安排。
“我们定下互相监督的规矩。每一族派出两名亲信，去往其余城门巡查，一旦发现麾下之人刻意懈怠御敌、只顾敌视外族，巡查之人有权上报各自首领，从重约束手下弟子。
各族只负责斩杀身前的异兽，城墙出现缺口，邻近城门要及时抽调人手支援。
若是有人固执己见，执意内耗，其余族群可以联手不予庇护。”
妖族首领皱起眉头，担心派人过去会被对方暗中算计，魔族主事忌惮人族借此安插眼线。
双方你来我往不断讨价还价，争论巡查人员的修为高低、轮换时长以及巡查期间不得随意插手对方族群内部事务。
草木长老最为赞同这套方案，灵体一族实力偏弱，若是能得到其余种族支援，它们的处境会安稳许多，一直从中调和气氛。
躲在楼阁外面墙体阴影里的林鹤清静静听着屋内的争论。
秦晏之这番提议十分中肯，互相帮扶打破孤立的局面，监督制度又可以约束被杂念影响的修士，正好戳中如今守城最大的弊病。
只是各族隔阂根深蒂固，想要落实依旧困难重重。
秦晏之耐下心来逐条商议细则，经过许久拉锯谈判，几人终于达成口头约定，待到夜幕降临之后正式执行。
林鹤清抬眼看向远处漆黑的虚空裂隙，心底十分清楚当下只是暴风雨来临前的沉寂。
各族修士眼下肆意放纵心中偏见，今日这份协定若是能够切实落地，孤城今夜才有撑下去的希望。
商议结束之后，白日缓缓铺开，这片孤城的上空依旧被一层厚重云层笼罩，看不到烈日，可散开云层的漫射天光洒落城墙各处。
夜里悄悄滋长的杂念在光亮之下慢慢收敛，潜藏在心底的猜忌与敌意被天光压制下去，修士们的理智重新占据上风。
白天异兽来袭的数量依旧平稳，四门全程没有出现濒临破防的危急状况。
各族按照方才敲定的约定陆续安排巡查之人，跨种族的巡守者往来于四座城墙之间。
东门这边，人族修士收敛排挤心态，见到草木灵体被异兽围困，不再刻意拖延出手时机。

灵体一族放下满心戒备，看到人族修士孤身陷入苦战，也会调动草木本源之力帮着牵制异兽。
慕星云四人依旧混在人族修士之中，一边斩杀魔物，一边留意巡查制度落实情况。
藤皇藏在墙体缝隙，只在紧要关头出手，不再需要频繁收拾疏漏。
北门之内，妖族手下依照约定派出族人前往西门巡查。
大部分妖修不再时刻紧盯魔族方向，把更多心神放在斩杀异兽上面。
黑豆依旧潜伏外墙阴影，只是需要它善后的漏网之敌已经少了大半。
妖族首领借着巡查往来，和魔族主事偶尔碰面交谈，双方态度较之昨夜缓和不少。
西门城头，魔族修士收敛之前摆烂敷衍的心态，不再放任异兽盘踞外墙。
派往北门的魔族巡守如实传回妖族那边的真实状况，破除了不少凭空生出的谣言。
林鹤清依旧待在高处的暗影里，只是今天需要他出手斩杀的异兽首领寥寥无几。
南门的鬼修和尸修也迫于各族监督，不得不主动上前对抗异兽，不再一心只顾收割魂魄，墙体破损的地方趁着白日空闲陆续修补妥当。

The latest chapter of A Mortal Cultivating Immortality, I’m Just a Passerby_Chapter 722 Mixed Combat Page 1_A Mortal Cultivating Immortality, I’m Just a Passenger’s Consumables_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 722 Hybrid Combat (Page 1)
Seeing the hesitation on the other people's faces, he continued to explain the supporting arrangements.
"We have established rules for mutual supervision. Each clan sends two close followers to patrol the remaining city gates. Once it is discovered that the people under their command are deliberately slacking off in fending off enemies and only focusing on being hostile to foreign clans, the patrolling people have the right to report to their respective leaders and strictly restrain their disciples.
Each tribe is only responsible for killing the strange beasts in front of them. If there is a gap in the city wall, nearby city gates must mobilize manpower to support them in time.
If someone is stubborn and insists on internal strife, other ethnic groups can join forces and not protect him. "
The leader of the demon clan frowned, worried that sending someone there would be secretly plotted by the other party. The leader of the demon clan was afraid that the human clan would use this to set up spies.
The two sides kept bargaining back and forth, arguing about the level of cultivation of the patrol personnel, the length of rotation, and the prohibition of arbitrarily interfering in the internal affairs of the other group during the patrol.
Elder Caomu is most in favor of this plan. The spirit clan is relatively weak. If they can get support from other races, their situation will be much more stable and they can always adjust the atmosphere.
Lin Heqing, who was hiding in the shadow of the wall outside the pavilion, listened quietly to the argument in the room.
Qin Yanzhi's proposal is very pertinent. They help each other break the isolation situation, and the supervision system can restrain the monks who are affected by distracting thoughts. It just hits the biggest shortcoming of the current city defense.
However, the estrangement between various ethnic groups is deep-rooted, and it is still difficult to implement it.
Qin Yanzhi patiently discussed the details one by one. After a long period of back-and-forth negotiations, they finally reached a verbal agreement, which was officially implemented after nightfall.
Lin Heqing raised his eyes and looked at the dark crack in the void in the distance, knowing very well in his heart that the moment was just the silence before the storm.
The monks of all races are now letting go of their prejudices. If today's agreement can be effectively implemented, the lonely city will have hope to survive tonight.
After the discussion, the day slowly spread out, and the sky above this isolated city was still shrouded by a thick layer of clouds. The scorching sun could not be seen, but the diffuse skylight that dispersed the clouds fell all over the city wall.
The distracting thoughts that grew quietly at night slowly converged under the light. The suspicion and hostility hidden in the heart were suppressed by the light of day, and the monks' reason regained the upper hand.
The number of alien beasts attacking during the day remained stable, and there was no critical situation on the verge of breaking through the four gates throughout the entire process.
Each tribe successively arranged patrols according to the agreement that had just been finalized, and cross-ethnic patrols traveled between the four city walls.
On the east gate side, the human monks restrained their rejection mentality. Seeing the vegetation spirits being surrounded by strange beasts, they no longer deliberately delayed the opportunity to take action.
The spirit clan put down their full guard, and when they saw the human monks trapped in a bitter battle alone, they would mobilize the original power of vegetation to help contain the alien beasts.
The four of them, Mu Xingyun, still mingled among the human monks, killing monsters while paying attention to the implementation of the inspection system.
The Vine Emperor hides in the cracks in the wall and only takes action at critical moments. He no longer needs to clean up the oversights frequently.
Within the north gate, the demon tribe's subordinates sent people to the west gate to inspect as agreed.
Most demon cultivators no longer keep an eye on the direction of the demons and focus more on killing strange beasts.
Black Bean is still lurking in the shadow of the exterior wall, but the number of enemies that need it to deal with the aftermath has been reduced by half.
The leader of the demon clan occasionally met and talked with the leader of the demon clan through inspections. The attitude of both parties was much more relaxed than last night.
At the top of Ximen City, the demon monks restrained their previous perfunctory mentality and no longer allowed the alien beasts to occupy the outer walls.
The Demon Clan patrol sent to the North Gate truthfully reported back the real situation on the Demon Clan's side, dispelling many rumors that were spun out of thin air.
Lin Heqing still stayed in the shadows high up, but there were only a few strange beast leaders that he needed to kill today.
The ghost cultivators and corpse cultivators in the south gate were also forced to take the initiative to go to the temple under the supervision of various clans.Instead of focusing on harvesting souls, the damaged parts of the wall were repaired one after another during the day.
